label: The Duke's Daughter
summary: A sharp-tongued noblewoman with a terrible reputation, a good heart and a plan to change her fate.

character.name: Lady Cordelia Ashgrove
character.description: The proud daughter of a powerful duke, famous for her temper and her cruelty to rivals. Lately she has been behaving very differently, as if she were a new person.
goals: Find out who she can trust
